symbology_direction.primary_symbolic_representation: a threshold scene where a still figure, lit doorway, and fragile key carry the grief of return without resolution
symbology_direction.rationale: The threshold scene preserves the central pressure between return and refusal.

style_direction.rationale: Cinematic photoreal grounding keeps the domestic threshold physically real while restrained surreal lighting preserves opacity.

visual_dynamics.target_visual_engine: sparse cinematic threshold composition with active absence and held motion

active_visual_tensions.name: Light / Dark
translation_notes: Use a lit doorway as the bright anchor inside a darker concrete environment.

active_visual_tensions.name: Flat / Deep
translation_notes: Build a clear inside/outside depth axis through the doorway.

style_visual_conflicts.conflict: Photoreal style could over-literalize the room and reduce the text's opacity.
style_visual_conflicts.adaptation: Use photoreal grounding with restrained surreal lighting and symbolic treatment of the key.

image_roles.composition_intent: Hold the figure at the edge of the lit doorway without resolving entry or departure.

series_plan.style_progression: No progression; one compressed threshold beat.

traceability_summary.note: The image plan translates the shared threshold beat into one still composition.
